reviewerChecklist.item: Confirm this receipt is the only PR-package artifact added after the bound pre-receipt HEAD and that the submitted diff remains within intended scope.
Review every path in boundedDiffInventory, with particular attention to the contracts, downloader-policy harness, release manifest and Docker profile changes.
Confirm Operating Model 1.1 and D-001 through D-007 remain preserved and that the prior pilot rejection and no-release decisions are not promoted or replaced.
Confirm synthetic fixture attribution is retained and no official Wikimedia content, licence, compatibility, pilot or redistribution claim is inferred from metadata-only fixtures.
Run CI-01 through CI-07 on the authoritative pinned-Node host and attach exact outputs; do not treat this worker's exit 133 as a product failure or success.
For the Docker profile, build and inspect the image and run CI-06 before accepting the no-data-image source attestation as runtime evidence.
Confirm no push, PR submission, merge, release, publication, credential, remote, provider, service or CI-authority action is requested by this package.

decision.reason: The bounded source inventory, criterion matrix, licence and attribution boundaries, no-data image source attestation, reviewer checklist and repeatable command manifest are present. The required diff check passed. Local Node aborted with exit 133 before lint, build and the focused test could begin; Docker daemon availability alone does not establish a Docker test result. The package is prepared for review, not submitted, and no runtime, image, official-content, licence, pilot, release or CI success is claimed.
